annotations.title: Create or rename an app role

description: Create a business role of an app's project, or change the label of an existing one (calling again with the same key and a label updates the label). A role is only a name; what it may do is written in the board policies. Example: key "manager", label "Agents manager". Roles can also come from the data itself with set_policy_identity (an employees board with a role column) instead of grant_app_role per person. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

key.description: Role key, e.g. "manager". Lowercase letters, digits, dash or underscore are safest; "*" and "public" are built in and cannot be defined

label.description: Display name, e.g. "Agents manager". Defaults to the key

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: define_app_role
